title: Rhetorical technique Practice 2
description: 4 short texts - 8 focused rhetorical technique questions
subject: rla
passage:
TEXT A - Before and After

A photo essay shows the same vacant lot before cleanup and six months after it became a small community garden.

TEXT B - Training Analogy

The instructor compares a safety checklist to a pilot's preflight routine: both are meant to catch small problems before they become serious.

TEXT C - Bus Data

A proposal notes that 41 percent of surveyed late-shift workers reported missing the final bus at least once in the previous month.

TEXT D - Repair Urgency

"Fix the leak before the ceiling stains spread. Fix the wiring before another breaker fails. Fix the building while it is still repairable."
